title: Riverhog provenance v1 journal entry
description: One immutable entry in a hash-chained RFC 7464 per-file provenance journal.

utcDateTime.description: RFC 3339 date-time normalized to UTC with uppercase Z and at most nanosecond precision.

digest.description: A cryptographic digest assertion. Content digests identify byte equality evidence, not file-entity identity.

text_role.description: Required when text and bytes coexist.

nativeMetadata.description: Source-native metadata evidence separated from any interpretation and from restoration semantics.

coverage.description: Exhaustiveness status for every filesystem capture category. Complete concerns accountable enumeration under the declared plan, not universal retention.

environment.description: Host/OS/filesystem/runtime state used by an observation or transition; a PROV Entity, not an Agent merely because execution occurred there.

entryReference.description: Reference to the exact UTF-8 JSON-text octets of an earlier journal entry, excluding RFC 7464 RS/LF framing.

fileLineage.description: An abstract continuing file lineage. Each immutable state is a specialization of one lineage; grouping is an attributable continuity assertion, not inferred from path or digest alone.

contentDescription.description: Opaque primary byte-stream observations only: length and cryptographic fixity. Internal format, codec, dimensions, duration, and other byte semantics are outside the core profile.

fileState.description: One immutable, full observed snapshot of one operating-system regular-file state; a PROV Entity and PREMIS File.

captureEvent.description: Observation Activity/PREMIS Event that used a file state and technical environment to generate provenance assertions. It does not generate the file state.

processEvidence.description: Evidence supporting the asserted process type. Activity labels such as transcode are process provenance, never inferred from payload bytes unless explicitly marked as a comparison-based inference.

transitionActivity.description: A real-world Activity/PREMIS Event that used, generated, or invalidated file states. It is distinct from observation capture.

payloadBinding.description: Append-only assertion binding a journal state to a payload locator relative to the sidecar. The latest effective event per role determines the current binding.

semanticAssertion.description: URI-named semantic assertion over the closed typed-value union. It cannot redefine core Riverhog provenance semantics.

graphFragment.description: An immutable atomic bundle of graph assertions. Arrays are semantic sets; array order does not imply chronology or causality.

correctionBody.description: Monotonic correction of prior assertion entries. Supersession changes the effective provenance description; it never denotes a change to the file itself.

checkpointBody.description: A cumulative checkpoint over exact RFC 7464 bytes through the preceding entry. Tail truncation is detectable only when a checkpoint or tail digest is anchored externally.
